channel.bio:
FREE DIGITAL ATHLETIC RECRUITING PRODUCTS  👇
Helping student-athletes and parents navigate the college athletic recruiting process with real NCAA coach insights. Learn how to get recruited for college sports, email college coaches, build a realistic school list, and understand Division II and III recruiting, scholarships, NIL rules, and the transfer portal.

Your step-by-step road map to college athletic recruiting — from Coach Keith Mondillo, an NCAA Head Coach and Director of Athletics with 30+ years of experience and 500+ wins. Each week, Keith breaks down what college coaches actually look for, how to communicate the right way, and how families can take control of recruiting without wasting time or money.

Subscribe for weekly videos on college recruiting tips, compliance truths, and real advice from a coach who’s been on the other side of the desk.
